plans.angle: One $1 can of chickpeas, three dinners for a broke week.
plans.hook: "This can cost me a dollar. It's about to be three dinners."

plans.twist: Show the price per meal on screen after each use.

25–30s: three plates side by side, total cost

Close-up of chickpeas hitting the pan
Wide of all three plates together

plans.angle: One $8 thrifted mirror, three looks for a tiny entryway.
plans.hook: "I paid $8 for this mirror. Here are three ways to make it look expensive."
keep: The mirror alone in the first frame
plans.twist: Every look is renter-safe and labelled 'no holes'.
structure: 0–2s: mirror held up, hook as text
2–9s: leaning on the floor with a plant
9–17s: hung on a removable hook above a stool
17–25s: propped on a shelf with books
25–30s: quick cuts of all three, 'which one?'
shots: Tripod wide of the entryway for each look
Same framing for all three looks
assets: Plant, stool and books already at home

Save the vote result as the next video idea
